description: Independent paginated readback of available inventory at the destination default location.
name: product import inventory page

parameters.value: {"query":"query ImportInventory($productId: ID!, $locationId: ID!, $after: String) { product(id: $productId) { id variants(first: 2, after: $after) { nodes { id sku inventoryQuantity inventoryItem { id tracked inventoryLevel(locationId: $locationId) { quantities(names: [\"available\"]) { name quantity } } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }"}
